title: Converge Learn-it Atlas on one learning journey
purpose: Implement the smallest coherent Phase A change authorized by issue #352 so every Atlas learning action converges on the existing Atlas session engine, an active activity owns the learner surface, learner-facing implementation jargon is removed, and persisted history, resume, review-needed, lineage, revisions, imports, storage and accessibility behavior remain intact.
invariants: Atlas learning actions from Today and Library enter the same existing Atlas planner/session engine; no third runtime or learner mode is introduced.
An active Atlas activity hides Today chrome, the classic Library surface, unrelated Atlas course cards and replanning controls while keeping prompt and answers contiguous.
Atlas event commits, history, resume state, review-needed semantics, package/course/activity lineage, revision IDs/digests and import behavior are unchanged.
No storage schema, database version, migration, backend, account or sync behavior is introduced.
learnit.kit.v2 and all EPF kit payloads remain unchanged.
Keyboard/focus behavior remains based on the existing Atlas controls and focus assertions.
requiredEvidence: PR scope validates exactly against ATLAS-WP-024.
Learn-it Next CI runs the bounded atlas-ux-convergence profile inside the existing workflow on the exact PR head, using only the current build and existing relevant tests.
Existing Atlas integration and UX clarity tests cover Library routing, exclusive active surface, minimal learner context, contiguous prompt/answers and learner-copy cleanup.
The deterministic Learn-it Next source manifest is rebound to every changed manifest-owned source.
No learner usability PASS is declared before Stream 2 human observation.
adversarialTests: apps/learnit-next/tests/atlas_m1_int.py checks that Atlas Library actions cannot fall through to the classic learning handler and that active sessions suppress competing surfaces.
apps/learnit-next/tests/atlas_m2_ux_clarity.py checks the revised learner-facing summary copy while retaining prior Atlas UX clarity coverage.
nonGoals: Changing EPF kits or the learnit.kit.v2 contract.
Migrating or merging classic and Atlas storage.
Adding backend, accounts, sync, a theory/discovery mode, a third runtime or a dashboard redesign.
Creating a new contradictory-QA chain or declaring human usability PASS.
independentReview: Issue #352 is the sole implementation authority and already contains the frozen Dream Team, Linus and Steve arbitration.
A future Stream 2 human observation owns the learner-usability verdict; this implementation stream must not self-certify UX PASS.
rollback: Close or revert PR #354. The baseline storage, contracts, EPF kits and pre-existing Atlas/classic persisted data remain unchanged.
